tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Week 4 is live and Kevin leads Mitchum 18.6-14.5 in what shapes up as the most consequential game in the mid-table right now. Fourth place versus third. RDC versus DEEP. Every point matters in this one.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles has scored 174, 548.5 cumulative, and is 6-0. Ryan walks in at 3-3. The Ledger does not hype matchups but it does read scoreboards, and that scoreboard is not ambiguous.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: FRONGE IS UP 14.1 TO NOTHING AND SHAQ HAS ZERO POINTS. ZERO. MWB AT $90.42 ON THE EXCHANGE, NO RB DEPTH, NO POINTS ON THE BOARD, AND THE DEFENDING NON-ANSWER TO THE RB QUESTION IS STILL THE DEFENDING NON-ANSWER. I AM NOT CALM.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I went 7-5 last week and my lock hit, so let me be direct about something: Terrence is at 5-7. I flagged Terrence's process issues before the season started. The record is public and it is sacred and it says five and seven.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Five and seven is a number, not a eulogy. The games I missed were closer than the pick-em board reflects and this week I have opinions that are going to age well. That is all I have to say right now.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Eight and four, locks two-for-two, and Terrence just said his losses were 'closer than the board reflects.' The board does not reflect closeness, Terrence. It reflects correct and incorrect. I want to talk about this on air. I want a full segment.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Drew is actually leading this Wingard game 15.4 to 11.7 right now. ATLAS. Leading. I am not saying it holds but I want the moment documented before the universe corrects itself.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Adam dropping $61 FAAB on Konata Mumpfield and $32 on Kendre Miller in the same week tells you exactly where HLX thinks it is in the standings — in a fight at 2-4, not patient-rebuilding. That is a scoreboard read, not an asset strategy.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Kevin versus Mitchum sitting at 18.6-14.5 live is the game I will not be stepping away from today. Fourth at 4-2 versus third at 4-2, and both sides of that record came from genuinely different places. The Ledger's full breakdown drops tonight.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Everyone clowning on Brent's 89-point loss last week — OBS is at $75.32, up 13.9%, and Bowers hasn't played a bad game, the supporting cast has. My model treats those as separable problems and Corbishley should not sleep on that distinction heading into this matchup.
